description:
Multiplatform VHF/HF ham radio contest logbook.


- MNI TNX to testers: OK1USW, OK5DF, OE3JPC
- Android has files in Downloads folder
- Android two finger zoom
- Android build 64+32bit starting API28 (Android 9)
- Windows are supported since Windows 7 SP1, both 64+32 bits
- Removed obsolete SDL1, SDR, Cygwin, MINGW, LPT (inpout32.dll), titlpage, qsl.ps
- Only TTF fonts (no round frames)
- Internal UTF-8/unicode encoding
